question: Which region made the most revenue?
goldSql: SELECT r.name, SUM(o.total) FROM orders o JOIN regions r ON r.id = o.region_id GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY SUM(o.total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many customers per region?
goldSql: SELECT r.name, COUNT(*) FROM customers c JOIN regions r ON r.id = c.region_id GROUP BY r.name

question: Total quantity sold per category
goldSql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category

question: How many orders were refunded?
goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'refunded'

question: What is the average order total?
Which product category has the highest average price?
goldSql: SELECT category, AVG(price) FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY AVG(price) DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the five most expensive products
goldSql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many orders are there for each status?
goldSql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status
